2- or 4-way NVIDIA NVLink bridge: 900GB/s per GPU

notes.zh: 回答 PCIe 风冷形态的 141GB 卡能怎么组：功耗上限低于 SXM 版本，适合低功耗风冷机架。关键约束是互联——NVLink 桥只支持 2 路或 4 路，凑不出 SXM 那种 8 卡全互联，多卡训练要按 PCIe 与桥接拓扑重新估算通信开销。
notes.en: Answers how the 141 GB card can be assembled in a PCIe air-cooled form: its power ceiling is below the SXM variant, which suits lower-power air-cooled racks. The binding constraint is interconnect — the NVLink bridge covers only 2-way or 4-way, so it cannot reproduce the 8-way fabric of SXM and multi-card training must be re-estimated against a PCIe and bridge topology.

specs.interconnect: 2- or 4-way NVLink bridge at 900 GB/s per GPU; PCIe Gen5 128 GB/s
specs.MIG: up to 7 instances at 16.5 GB each
